CustomField.description: The copy of Readout_Data__c taken at the moment of approval, exactly as Approved_Content__c is the copy of Draft_Content__c. GtmReadoutPublicController serves this one, never Readout_Data__c, so the structured half of a published readout is fixed by the approval in the same way the prose half is. Written by GtmReadoutApprovalHandler.stampApproval.
CustomField.label: Approved Data
